caption: A wet umbrella is flicked sharply and stopped short, and the water drops fly off the tip and keep going in the direction of the flick.

sa.check: A wet umbrella is flicked sharply.
Water drops fly off the tip.
The drops carry on the way the flick was heading.
The umbrella is visibly wet before the flick.
The flick and its stop come first, then the drops leave the tip.

pc.expect: The drops leave at the moment the umbrella is stopped, neither before the flick begins nor long after it ends.
pc.fail: Drops fly off while the umbrella is being held still; or they leave before the flick starts; or they keep streaming off long after the umbrella has stopped.

pc.expect: Each drop leaves along the direction the tip was travelling and holds that direction as it flies.
pc.fail: The drops follow the umbrella back as it is stopped; or they spray out equally in every direction from the tip; or they hang beside the umbrella without moving away.

pc.expect: Once free, the drops curve downward and fall toward the ground.
pc.fail: A drop climbs steadily after leaving the tip; or a drop hangs still in the air; or the drops hold a flat line all the way to the edge of the frame.

pc.expect: The water leaves as rounded drops or a fine spray, shed from the surface of the fabric.
pc.fail: The water leaves as a rigid shard that keeps its shape; or drops stretch into long threads that stay joined to the tip; or the fabric looks dry while water is plainly flying off it.

pc.expect: The umbrella keeps its shape and water leaves it only by flying off it.
pc.fail: The umbrella vanishes or turns into another object; or drops appear in the air away from the umbrella; or a rib passes through the fabric.

pc.expect: The umbrella's colour and panels and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The umbrella changes colour during the flick; or its panels change pattern; or the background rearranges between frames.
